programStages.name: Case Report
programStages.description: Unified case report for acute viral hepatitis (A–E). Covers clinical presentation, exposure history, laboratory results, vaccination history, hospitalization, outcome, and final case classification.

programs.name: Acute Viral Hepatitis Case Report
programs.description: Unified case-based surveillance for acute viral hepatitis (A–E). Based on the WHO Template case report form for acute viral hepatitis (WHO, 2018) and WHO VPD Surveillance Standards 2018 for hepatitis A and B.

programRuleActions.content: Specimen collection status must be recorded before completing this event.
At least one age field is required. Date of Birth is preferred; use Age in Years or Age in Months if Date of Birth is unavailable.
Test result does not correspond to case classification (Hep E lab-confirmed)
Date of symptom onset cannot be later than the date of visit.
Test result does not correspond to case classification (Hep B lab-confirmed)

Classification requirements: (1) A laboratory-confirmed classification requires a Positive result for the corresponding biomarker in the Laboratory and Biomarkers section (Anti-HAV IgM for Hepatitis A, IgM anti-HBc for Hepatitis B, HCV RNA for Hepatitis C, Anti-HEV IgM for Hepatitis E). (2) An epidemiologically linked classification requires Contact with a Laboratory-Confirmed Case to be set to Yes in the Case Linkage section. The record cannot be saved if the classification and the supporting data are inconsistent.
Test result does not correspond to case classification (Hep C lab-confirmed)
Test result does not correspond to case classification (Hep A lab-confirmed)
Please record the result for every laboratory test performed, including tests with Negative, Pending, or Indeterminate results. If a test was not performed, leave the field blank.
An epidemiologically linked classification requires confirmed contact with a laboratory-confirmed case. Please set Contact with a Laboratory-Confirmed Case to Yes, or revise the classification.
A laboratory-confirmed classification requires a specimen to have been collected. Please set Specimen Collected to Yes, or revise the classification.

programRules.name: Always hide AVH_HEPE_FINALCLASS
programRules.description: Hides Hepatitis E final classification. This value is set by a program rule based on the overall final case classification.

programRules.name: Completion: Sex Required
programRules.description: Ensuring that the patient's sex is recorded.

programRules.name: Completion: IgM anti-HBc required for Hepatitis B lab-confirmed classification
programRules.description: Ensuring that the test result is recorded for a Hep B lab-confirmed classification.

programRules.name: Classification: Hepatitis C — Laboratory-confirmed
programRules.description:
If the final case classification is Hepatitis C - Lab-confirmed  then: 
1) Set Hep C case classification to Lab confirmed
2) Set Hep A, Hep B, and Hep E case classifications to Discarded

programRules.name: Completion: Anti-HEV IgM required for Hepatitis E lab-confirmed classification
programRules.description: Ensuring that the test result is recorded for a Hep E lab-confirmed classification.

programRules.name: Hide Hepatitis B Vaccination Details when Not Vaccinated
programRules.description: Hide fields for details when the patient was not vaccinated with Hep B vaccine.

programRules.name: Completion: At least one age field required
programRules.description: Ensuring that at least one of the fields in the form that allows for determining patient's age is completed.

programRules.name: Always hide AVH_HEPA_FINALCLASS
programRules.description: Hides Hepatitis A final classification. This value is set by a program rule based on the overall final case classification.

programRules.name: Completion: Date of Onset Required
programRules.description: Ensuring that a date of symptom onset is recorded.

programRules.name: Reminder: Record All Laboratory Tests Performed
programRules.description: Show reminder to enter all available test results.

programRules.name: Classification: Hepatitis E — Laboratory-confirmed
programRules.description:
If the final case classification is Hep E - Lab confirmed then: 
1) Set Hep E case classification to Lab confirmed
2) Set Hep A, Hep B, and Hep C case classifications to Discarded

programRules.name: Classification: Hepatitis A — Epidemiologically linked
programRules.description:
If the final case classification is Hepatitis A - Epidemiologically linked then: 
1) Set Hep A case classification to EpiLinked
2) Set Hep B, Hep C, and Hep E case classifications to Discarded

programRules.name: Error: Specimen required for lab-confirmed classification
programRules.description: Ensuring that a collected specimen is recorded consistent with a lab-confirmed case classification.

programRules.name: Note: Final Case Classification Requirements
programRules.description: Show reminder of final case classification criteria.

programRules.name: Error: Contact with confirmed case required for epi-linked classification
programRules.description: Ensuring that contact with a confirmed case is recorded consistent with epi-linked case classification (Hep A or Hep E).

programRules.name: Completion: HCV RNA required for Hepatitis C lab-confirmed classification
programRules.description: Ensuring that the test result is recorded for a Hep C lab-confirmed classification.

programRules.name: Hide Age in Months when DOB entered or Age Years > 0
programRules.description: Hides the Age in Months field if DOB or Age in Years >= 1 are recorded.

programRules.name: Completion: Anti-HAV IgM required for Hepatitis A lab-confirmed classification
programRules.description: Ensuring that the test result is recorded for a Hep A lab-confirmed classification.

programRules.name: Assign Event Date to Date of Visit and Hide Field
programRules.description: Hides the Date of Visit field and sets its value  to the event date. This avoids duplication in the data entry form while allowing the Date of Visit field to be used in downstream queries and visualizations.

programRules.name: Hide Laboratory Fields when No Specimen Collected
programRules.description: Hide fields for laboratory tests when no collected specimen is recorded.

programRules.name: Hide Hepatitis E Vaccination Details when Not Vaccinated
programRules.description: Hide field for details when the patient was not vaccinated with Hep E vaccine.

programRules.name: Always hide AVH_HEPB_FINALCLASS
programRules.description: Hides Hepatitis B final classification. This value is set by a program rule based on the overall final case classification.

programRules.name: Classification: Hepatitis A — Laboratory-confirmed
programRules.description:
If the final case classification is Hep A - Lab-confirmed then: 
1) Set Hep A case classification to LabConfirmed
2) Set Hep B, Hep C, and Hep E case classifications to Discarded

programRules.name: Hide Hospitalization and Discharge Dates when Not Hospitalized
programRules.description: Hide fields for details of hospitalization when patient was not hospitalized.

programRules.name: Classification: Hepatitis E — Epidemiologically linked
programRules.description:
If the final case classification is Hep E - Epidemiologically linked then: 
1) Set Hep E case classification to EpiLinked
2) Set Hep A, Hep B, and Hep C case classifcations to Discarded

programRules.name: Always hide AVH_HEPC_FINALCLASS
programRules.description: Hides Hepatitis C final classification. This value is set by a program rule based on the overall final case classification.

programRules.name: Classification: Non-viral — set ABCE to Discarded
programRules.description: If the final overall case classication is Nonviral then set Hep A, Hep B, Hep C, and Hep E classifications to Discarded

programRules.name: Classification: Hepatitis B — Laboratory-confirmed
programRules.description:
If the final case classification is Hepatitis B - Lab-confirmed  then: 
1) Set Hep B case classification to Lab confirmed
2) Set Hep A, Hep C, and Hep E case classifications to Discarded

programRules.name: Completion: Final Case Classification Required
programRules.description: Case cannot be marked as complete without a final case classification.

programRules.name: Completion: Specimen Collected is required
programRules.description: Ensuring that specimen collection (Yes/No/Unknown) is documented.

programRules.name: Hide Associated Case ID when No Contact with Case
programRules.description: Hide field for associated case ID when there's no contact with a confirmed case.

programRules.name: Error: Onset date after visit date
programRules.description: Ensuring that the date of symptom onset is not later than the date of the visit.

programRules.name: Hide HCV RNA unless Anti-HCV Positive
programRules.description: Hide HCV RNA details unless Anti-HCV is Positive

programRules.name: Hide Hepatitis A Vaccination Details when Not Vaccinated
programRules.description: Hide fields for details when the patient was not vaccinated with Hep A vaccine.

programRules.name: Hide HBV Genotype unless HBsAg Positive
programRules.description: Hide field for HBV Genotype unless HBsAg test result is Positive.

programRules.name: Completion: Unique Identifier Required
Hide Combined Hepatitis A+B Vaccination Details when Not Vaccinated
programRules.description: Hide field for details when the patient was not vaccinated with Hep A+B vaccine.

programRules.name: Hide Date of Death when Outcome is not Death
programRules.description: Hide date of death field when the outcome is not death.
